image_brief: Shelter cat Gregory raised $10,000 for his old shelter by starring in a space calendar

slides.headline: A SHELTER CAT MADE $10,000 STARRING IN HIS OWN CALENDAR

caption:
The saddest cat in the shelter raised $10,000 for the place he came from

Andrew McCarthy walked into a shelter 2 years ago and chose the saddest cat there. That cat, Gregory, starred in a calendar and raised $10,000 for the exact shelter he came from. Preorders for the 2027 edition are already open on his 2-year adoption anniversary, and Andrew says this year will raise even more. If you've ever walked into a shelter, you know exactly which cat Gregory was. The saddest one in the room turned out to be its biggest fundraiser.

Most people walk past the hard cases. Andrew didn't, and Gregory paid it back twice over.

pinned_comment: The part we couldn't fit: the calendar is called Cosmic Gregory, and every photo shows him dressed as an astronaut. A shelter cat in a space suit fundraising for the place that once had him.
